flashcard_questions.q: The system of glands that produce hormones and release them into the blood to regulate body processes.
The monthly cycle of changes in the female reproductive system, typically lasting around 28 days, controlled by hormones.
The main male reproductive hormone, produced by the testes, which stimulates sperm production and the development of secondary sexual characteristics.

flashcard_questions.a: Follicle stimulating hormone — released by the pituitary gland, it causes an egg to mature in the ovary and stimulates the ovaries to produce oestrogen.
A hormone produced by the ovaries that causes the uterus lining to thicken and inhibits further FSH production.
